Explicit (user-supplied) anchor pixels

Source: R/metric-anchors.R
ef_anchors.Rd

Builds the anchor pixels of the METRIC calibration from cells or coordinates chosen by the user (manual selection, required by dev/SCIENTIFIC_SPEC.md section 7). The result has the same class and the same audit table as ef_select_anchors(): the attributes of each anchor pixel are extracted from the same layers and the same statistics are computed, so that a manual selection is auditable in the same way.

Usage

ef_anchors(
  cold,
  hot,
  lst,
  ndvi,
  albedo,
  lai = NULL,
  land_cover = NULL,
  qa = NULL,
  elevation = NULL,
  utc_hour = NULL,
  homogeneity = NULL,
  aggregate,
  cell_size = NULL,
  origin = NULL,
  crs = NULL,
  station = NULL,
  inherited_flags = NULL,
  note = NULL
)

Arguments

cold, hot

Cell numbers (whole numbers, numbered row by row from the top left cell, as in terra) or a two-column matrix or data frame of coordinates x, y (cell centres or any point in the cell; needs origin, cell_size and crs). At least one per class; no cell may appear twice.

lst

Numeric vector or matrix. Surface temperature [K], > 0. Defines the grid: every other layer must have its length and dim.

ndvi

Numeric vector or matrix. NDVI [-], in [-1, 1].

albedo

Numeric vector or matrix. Broadband surface albedo [-], in [0, 1].

lai

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Leaf area index [m2 m-2], >= 0. Required if a criterion uses it.

land_cover

Numeric vector or matrix of class codes, or NULL. Required if a criterion uses it.

qa

Logical vector or matrix or NULL. TRUE for usable cells (quality control of the surface module); NULL means all cells are usable. No missing values.

elevation

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Elevation [m]; recorded and aggregated for the sensible heat calibration, not used by the selection.

utc_hour

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Overpass time of each cell as a decimal UTC hour, in [0, 24). Recorded; anchors of one class with different overpass times are flagged with EF_ANCHOR_OVERPASS_SPREAD.

homogeneity

NULL or an ef_homogeneity() object whose window statistics are recorded for each anchor (anchors are never discarded).

aggregate

Character. "mean", "median" or "none", as in ef_select_anchors(). No default.

cell_size

Numeric or NULL. Side of the (square) cells [m]; recorded (window size in metres) and needed with origin.

origin

Numeric c(x, y) or NULL. Coordinates of the top left corner of the grid in a projected CRS in metres; gives the coordinates of the anchor cell centres.

crs

Character or NULL. Coordinate reference system of origin and station (recorded only).

station

Numeric c(x, y) or NULL. Coordinates of the weather station; gives the distance from each anchor to the station [m]. Needs origin.

inherited_flags

NULL or a list of cell-scope earthflux_flag records evaluated upstream on the grid of lst (indices are positions of the R layers). The codes active at each anchor cell are recorded in pixels$inherited_flags (inheritance rule, dev/specs/flags.md section 3.4).

note

Character or NULL. Free text (reason for the selection).

Value

An object of class c("earthflux_anchors", "list") with the elements described in ef_select_anchors(); method = "manual", origin = "user", criteria, thresholds, search, funnel and relaxation are NULL, and the flag EF_ANCHOR_USER_SUPPLIED is present.

Details

Invariant: with the cells of an automatic selection, the same layers, the same homogeneity object and the same aggregate, pixels and calibration_points are identical to those of ef_select_anchors().

Errors: a cell or coordinate outside the grid raises earthflux_anchor_outside_grid (field index); a missing surface temperature at an anchor raises earthflux_anchor_na_input (fields variable, index); a hot calibration point not hotter than the cold one raises earthflux_anchor_inverted. All also inherit earthflux_anchor_error; the first two also earthflux_input_error.

See also

Other anchor pixel functions: ef_anchor_conditions(), ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_pick(), ef_anchor_rule(), ef_homogeneity(), ef_select_anchors()

Examples

lst <- matrix(c(300, 301, 299, 320,
                298, 300, 302, 322,
                297, 301, 300, 321), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
ndvi <- matrix(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.6, 0.1,
                 0.8, 0.5, 0.4, 0.1,
                 0.9, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
albedo <- matrix(0.2, nrow = 3, ncol = 4)
# Cells are numbered row by row: cell 9 is row 3, column 1
anchors <- ef_anchors(cold = 9, hot = 8, lst = lst, ndvi = ndvi,
                      albedo = albedo, aggregate = "none",
                      note = "irrigated field and fallow plot")
anchors$pixels[, c("type", "cell", "row", "col", "lst")]
#>   type cell row col lst
#> 1 cold    9   3   1 297
#> 2  hot    8   2   4 322
